title: A pool session's in-flight price is not credited with the overrun of its answered questions, so jobs above 1 start no session the cap would pass
goal: bench_pool.run_tasks counts a session in flight at no less than its unanswered questions' prices, not max(price - paid, 0), so a session whose first question billed 2.5 times its price keeps its remaining questions' price in the cap check and run_sessions starts no further session the cap would pass (SP-e4fm2ovk review, gap 5, S4: the overshoot is bounded by the overrun)
